reason: A local-first research workbench centered on processing papers, searching and comparing literature, fact-checking findings, and supporting review writing through project files and configurable agent integrations.

summaries.zh: 面向科研阅读与综述写作的本地优先工作台，支持论文解析、文献检索比较、事实核查和研究项目文件管理。
summaries.en: A local-first research workbench for paper processing, literature search and comparison, fact-checking, and research project file management.

capabilities: PDF parsing and structured paper extraction
